candidate.replaces: sherlock-k-a/1 physical Tree representation: one allocation per tree node occurrence in program literals and boundary states
candidate.by: hash-consed allocation per structurally distinct node (TreeInterner), applied to program literals and re-applied to every boundary state before Machine::from_snapshot resumes

preservation_predicate.statement: For the same program, fuel and stack limit, the candidate run has the same event count and per-event rule order, the same per-event charge and before/after remaining fuel, depth and stack limit, structurally equal complete before/after boundary states (code, control, environment, frames), the same outcome class (Done/Rejected(code)/Exhausted) and the same returned value. Physical node identity is not an observation; structural equality is.
preservation_predicate.first_divergence: returns the clause, event index and detail of the first difference

clauses.predicate: final Done value and every Value in each boundary state are structurally equal
outcome class and error code equal, including fuel exhaustion and K-A frame-cap Rejected(4)
same event count and rule_start_line sequence; no effects exist in this profile
every before/after step boundary and the initial and final states are complete-state equal; resumed boundaries are the interned states
ordered effects and residual duties equal; both are absent from sherlock-k-a/1 state
per-event charge, remaining fuel, initial fuel, logical depth and stack limit equal at every boundary

evidence.covers: fold over branch(branch(leaf 4, leaf 5), branch(leaf 4, leaf 5)) at fuel 512/stack 32 (Done 18), fuel 20 (Exhausted), stack 2 (Rejected 4); unsound shape-only merge and changed budget are rejected

evidence.reason: Snapshot has no effect, duty, liability or financial field; there is nothing for interning to reorder or drop

unresolved_gaps.statement: Only one fold program and three budgets are run; other programs, list values and other error codes (error1..error10 except 4) are not exercised. No proof that interning preserves equality for all states.
Effectful/financial profiles (Core/2 typed await, sherlock-helper-microstep/2 finance) are not covered; preservation of ordered effects and residual duties is unexamined there.

Only sherlock-k-a/1 step boundaries are compared. B helper-microstep chunk/A4 project boundaries, bounded C6 images (data arena append-only, child-before-parent) and canonical encode/decode are not covered; interning there would change active lengths and capacity checks.
Host time, peak memory, preparation bytes, circuit rows, degree, key/proof size, prover/verifier time and target fees are unmeasured; B data/env capacity exhaustion under sharing is unexamined.

costs.metric: physical tree nodes of the entry literal
circuit rows, degree, key/proof bytes, prover/verifier time, fees
